label: On bare MORE_1 the strict comparative does not give 'no effect exceeds its total cause'
paraphrase: Closed mathematical control over a two-being, one-respect grades frame in which each being totally causes the other, both are in act, and the primitive comparative MORE_1 holds of every pair in both directions: the strict comparative (a distinct cause of a quality is more such) and 'more such has the perfection' hold, while the MORE_1 reading of 'at least as much reality in the total cause' (no effect is more r than its total cause) fails. A statement about this interpretation only: without an asymmetry or calibration premise, MORE_1's strict comparative does not yield the non-strict one.
